package.name: nav2_joy
package.description: Keyboard-to-joystick teleop package for Nav2. Provides a node that reads keyboard input in raw terminal mode and publishes sensor_msgs/Joy messages (simulating a physical joystick) plus a converter that maps the joystick state to geometry_msgs/Twist. Designed as a drop-in replacement for the "click on the route to set a goal" workflow, letting you drive the robot in simulation with the keyboard.
